'''Riot Mar's starfighter'''<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|num=75307|name=LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar}}</ref> was a customized<ref name="Handbook" /> [[Helix J-104 starfighter]]<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" /> used by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Riot Mar]]. Riot Mar's starfighter was destroyed by the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]]'s [[gunship]] the ''[[Razor Crest]]'', during a fight between the two in the [[Tatoo system]],<ref name="Chapter 5" /> in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Riot Mar's starfighter first appeared in "[[Chapter 5: The Gunslinger]]," an episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''<ref name="Chapter 5" /> that aired on [[December 6]], [[2019]].<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}}</ref> It was first named in the [[2021]] [[LEGO]] [[Star Wars]] Advent Calendar.<ref name="LEGO" />
